summary: City page re-read: $45 full hookup / $35 water-electric / $20 tent (monthly and May 15-Sep 15 seasonal rates too), showers, dump off site at Sunny's ($10). Lakeview kept after a hard look; the east-end pads are ~40-50 m from the boat landing but site numbers could not be read. Sites not rewritten (city text vs Campspot differ).
flags: WATERFRONT (checked hard): keep lakeview. Imagery and the city's aerial photo show the RV loop as open grass with scattered trees, looking south across the open beach and lot to Hill Lake about 70-90 m away. The pads at the loop's east end (around 46.9942,-93.5900) are roughly 40-50 m from the boat-landing shore (fishing dock at about 46.9938,-93.5895) across the open gravel landing lot; the rest of the east side has a tree-and-reed fringe between. That is at the edge of the 50 m line and over a public boat-landing lot rather than the site's own ground, and the site numbers could not be read (the city's 'Campsite Map.JPG' returns a Cloudflare page; Campspot's map did not load), so no upgrade. A reviewer with the site map could name the one or two pads nearest the landing for a lakefront-with-caveat call.
